In a Verily notebook/terminal cell: `echo $WORKSPACE_CDR` + `$GOOGLE_PROJECT`, then a 1-row in-perimeter probe `pd.read_gbq('SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM `{WORKSPACE_CDR}.person`', project_id=$GOOGLE_PROJECT)`. If VPC-SC blocks the probe -> fall back to the RW2.0 Dataset Builder UI export; Folder Sync of the stranded v9 TSV is last resort (additive, but confirm it cannot collide with the native ld/ dir first). Then: purge contaminated selfid intermediates+final -> FRESH AFR-sens re-fire (sensitivity=True, force_fresh=True, self_report_table_path=<resolved>; expect 0 < N_sens < 73,122) -> Cell 4.5 -> backfill cohort_summary_m3.tsv to 3 rows -> mv contaminated MT to ld/_forensics/ -> teardown (Stop NOT Delete) -> close debug session m3-W2-genome-wide-countcols-py4j-wedge to resolved/. STOP + surface only on: a traceback / a flatlined arbiter WITH the JVM live / an assertion failure. The interim 2-cohort path (AFR-primary + EUR) does NOT depend on any of this — it is already banked.
